title: 'Etherfather' gets four years in prison over CATFI memecoin rug pull
summary: Crypto influencer Park, known as "Etherfather," was sentenced to four years in prison on unfair trading charges, Digital Asset reported.The 11th Criminal Division of the Seoul Southern District Court also ordered forfeiture of about 223 million won ($160,000) after convicting Park of violating the Virtual Asset User Protection Act. An accomplice identified as A received two years and six months in prison and forfeiture of about 45 million won ($32,000), while B was sentenced to three years in prison, suspended for five years, along with forfeiture of about 75 million won ($54,000) and confiscation of 24 ETH.The defendants were indicted in May after allegedly spending several million won in early 2025 to issue CATFI, a Solana-based memecoin, on Pump.fun and list it on a decentralized exchange before carrying out a rug pull that generated 400 million won ($287,000) in illicit gains. more:

title: Seven Democratic senators oppose revised CLARITY Act
summary: Seven Democratic U.S. senators have also voiced opposition to a revised version of the CLARITY Act that adds ethics rules for public officials, increasing uncertainty over whether the bill can pass before the August recess, according to BeInCrypto. Sens. Catherine Cortez Masto, Angela Alsobrooks, Cory Booker, Ruben Gallego, John Hickenlooper, Mark Warner and Raphael Warnock said the bill still needs stronger provisions on consumer protection, illicit finance prevention and market integrity, not just ethics rules. Banking industry groups also said deposit risks remain a concern and argued the revised bill could still curb regional lending. Compared with the draft released in May, the revised version newly adds ethics rules restricting public officials from issuing or endorsing cryptocurrencies, as well as law enforcement provisions allowing the seizure of stablecoins. It keeps the existing framework under which the SEC and CFTC share oversight of cryptocurrencies.

title: Kazakhstan approves up to 10 years of power support for crypto miners
summary: Kazakhstan has approved rules for a strategic digital mining program that guarantee electricity supplies to cryptocurrency mining companies for up to 10 years, according to a report by a West Asian media outlet. Under the rules, participating companies can receive power allocations from electricity generators at capped rates. In return, they must transfer part of their mined cryptocurrency to Kazakhstan’s Silicon Valley, Astar Network, or a hub, and the assets will be held in trust by a state investment corporation under the central bank before being used to expand the country’s strategic crypto reserve.

summary: South Korean Rep. Kim said South Korea needs to prepare as broader dollar stablecoin adoption is expected after the GENIUS Act takes full effect in January next year and the U.S. market structure bill, the CLARITY Act, could come to a vote as early as next week.At the same event, when asked whether the government’s digital asset basic law on stablecoins would be released in the second half of the year, Kim Sung-jin, head of the virtual asset division at South Korea’s Financial Services Commission, said the schedule remains under discussion with relevant agencies and the National Assembly and that officials are working to move as quickly as possible, as outlined in the government’s economic policy direction for the second half. more:

title: Institutional BTC demand slows across ETFs, Strategy and accumulation firms
summary: On-chain analyst Darkfost said demand from spot Bitcoin ETFs, Strategy and corporate Bitcoin accumulation firms is all slowing. In a post on X, Darkfost said net inflows into spot ETFs over the past 30 days fell by $2.1 billion, while Strategy's purchase demand has stagnated for weeks. Demand from accumulation firms has also dropped from about $6.6 billion in August last year to effectively near zero now. Darkfost said the trend reflects market pessimism, but added that periods when demand from those buyers is at its lowest could instead offer a good time to build positions.
